title: Raja Vidya Raja Guhya Yoga
translation: The Yoga of the King of Knowledge and the King of Secrets
summary: Krishna reveals the most confidential knowledge of His divine nature and the path of unalloyed devotion as the easiest means to attain Him.

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते |
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् || २२ ||
verses.translation: But those who always worship Me with exclusive devotion, meditating on My transcendental form—to them I carry what they lack, and I preserve what they have.
verses.transliteration:
ananyāś cintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
teṣāṁ nityābhiyuktānāṁ yoga-kṣemaṁ vahāmy aham
verses.meaning: Ananyah - no other; Chintayantah - concentrating; Mam - on Me...
